advice.executiveSummary: Critical systemic failures in multi-turn context retention and template generation. Assistant loses company context between turns (UV019-UV022), generates unusable templates with placeholder garbage (UV001, UV004, UV006, UV016), and fails to distinguish manufacturers from retailers (UV001, UV012). Root causes: 1) Context carryover logic insufficient for company name hints across turns; 2) Template fill hints extraction fails to aggregate constraints from full conversation history; 3) Missing hard guardrails against retailer fallback when manufacturer intent is explicit.

priorityPlan.title: Fix template placeholder garbage generation
priorityPlan.why: Templates with 'уточняется' placeholders are completely unusable - user cannot send them to suppliers. Affects 4+ scenarios (UV001, UV004, UV006, UV016).
priorityPlan.expectedImpact: Template usefulness score rises from 0-1 to 3-4. Eliminates 'template generation completely broken' judge issue.

priorityPlan.title: Fix catastrophic context loss for company name carryover
priorityPlan.why: Assistant loses 'Ирис Интер групп' context between turns, hallucinates unrelated companies (hospitals, ministries). Affects UV019-UV022.
priorityPlan.expectedImpact: Company context retention across multi-turn flows. Eliminates 'complete context disconnect' and 'hallucinated response' judge issues.

priorityPlan.title: Fix manufacturer vs retailer classification
priorityPlan.why: Returns 'Глобал Шуз' (shoe store) as manufacturer; 'ЖК Трейд' (spare parts) as tractor seller. Affects UV001, UV008, UV012.
priorityPlan.expectedImpact: Correct business type filtering. Eliminates 'category mismatch' and 'wrong rubric' judge issues.

priorityPlan.title: Fix RFQ template parameter extraction from conversation history
priorityPlan.why: User specifies '500 кг', '3 дней', 'Минск' in earlier turns, but template contains only placeholders. Affects UV006, UV017.
priorityPlan.expectedImpact: Templates populated with actual conversation constraints. Eliminates 'RFQ template not usable' judge issues.

priorityPlan.title: Add checklist generation for explicit document requests
priorityPlan.why: Turn 4 in UV002 requests 'чеклист из 6 пунктов' - assistant ignores or returns generic advice instead of structured checklist.
priorityPlan.expectedImpact: Structured numbered checklists for document/verification requests. Improves usefulness for B2B procurement workflows.

recommendations.risk: May over-fill if user changed constraints mid-conversation. Mitigation: prefer most recent mention.

recommendations.implementationHint: app/src/app/api/ai/request/route.ts: lines 2742-2812. Add detectPlaceholderGarbage() call in postProcessAssistantReply before final output. If hasGarbage=true and placeholderCount>=3, force template regeneration with hints.

recommendations.risk: Slightly higher latency for template regeneration. Acceptable.

advice.executiveSummary: Critical template generation failure and context amnesia are the dominant failure modes. The assistant systematically outputs templates with literal 'уточняется' placeholders (7+ scenarios) and loses company context mid-conversation (4+ Iris Inter Group scenarios). These two issues alone account for 50%+ of judge complaints. Fixing template variable resolution and implementing explicit context carryover will have the highest ROI.
